title: Microsoft AI Chief Makes Rare Disclosure: Publicizes Key Metrics of MAI-2 Model in Response to OpenAI Transparency Initiative
excerpt: A rare moment of mutual candor among AI giants emerged on November 22. Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI, reposted an article by OpenAI Chief Scientist Jaku
content_html:
A rare moment of mutual candor among AI giants emerged on November 22. Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI, reposted an article by OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki and made it clear: Microsoft fully supports OpenAI’s initiative to increase transparency, and the two sides will share pretraining progress. That is no small commitment—pretraining data, methods, and progress have long been the most closely guarded assets of large-model companies, and now they are being put on a jointly public table.

Suleyman then offered a concrete number. With OpenAI’s permission, Microsoft disclosed that its in-house MAI-2 foundation model achieved a log perplexity of 0.819 on OpenAI’s evaluation dataset, putting it at a level close to the GPT-5.6 Sol foundation model. Perplexity is a core metric for measuring a language model’s ability to predict text; the lower the number, the more reliably the model grasps the patterns of language. Letting a third party run the evaluation of one’s own model, and allowing that party’s dataset to issue the report card, is itself a stance in the fiercely competitive frontier model world.

A further idea is to turn this kind of one-off candor into an industry norm. Suleyman said that AI safety and coordination should be the top priority of the entire industry, and Microsoft pledged to promote the establishment of common evaluation standards and a coordination mechanism for the pace of AI development. At a time when the race for model capabilities is charging ahead and every company, fearing it will be left behind, is quietly training harder, the willingness of two leading companies to turn over a layer of each other’s cards may be the beginning of installing the first public dashboard for this race.
